A '''patrol cruiser''' belonged to the [[Malarian Alliance]].

==Characteristics==
A patrol [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] used by the [[Malarian Alliance]] was 150 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length with a tapered bow. The symbol of the Alliance was painted on the bow. It was armed with [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], and its sensor array could be obscured by space dust. The ship had an attached boxy [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and [[Escape pod/Legends|life pods]]. The crew included a communications [[Officer/Legends|officer]], [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], and [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]]. The ship's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] had viewports.<ref name="SM4" />

==History==
In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]],<ref name="Discovery">[[Nuru Kungurama]] was discovered "11 years" before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The conflict starts in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], according to ''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''.</ref> the patrol cruiser was [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Krempil]] and assigned two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] observers, [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and [[Ring-Sol Ambase]], to hunt [[Hethra Mcgrrrr/Legends|Hethra Mcgrrrr's]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Black Hole Gang/Legends|gang]]. The crew tracked Mcgrrrr's ship, the ''[[Random Mallet]]'', to an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] near a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] at the edge of the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region. The cruiser fired on the ''Random Mallet,'' disabling its systems. After picking up a transmission in an alien language, the cruiser was hit by a [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]]. The impact destroyed the navigation console and caused a hull breach in the viewport. Krempil ordered an evacuation, but Dooku overruled him and adjusted the shields over the breach while Ambase sprayed sealant. The ''Random Mallet'' was able to jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], leaving the cruiser's crew to trace the transmission to a small spacecraft. Dooku and Ambase took the shuttle to dock with the craft and discovered an [[Chiss/Legends|alien]] baby. A data storage device provided the baby's name: [[Nuru Kungurama]]. The Jedi brought the baby back to their [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Temple]] while another task force was assigned to hunt McGrrrr.<ref name="SM4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The cruiser appears in the first chapter of [[Ryder Windham]]'s [[2012]] young readers novel, ''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]'', which serves as a distant prologue.
